events.description: Susan Bunch says Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick should not shout right now.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch, Carol Willick, and Ross Geller need a name for Ben Geller.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch likes the name "Ben" for the baby.
Carol Willick says the name "Ben" is good for the baby.
Carol Willick says Ross Geller has never mentioned the name "Ben" before.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, and Carol Willick just came up with the name "Ben".
Susan Bunch says Ross Geller, Susan Bunch, Monica Geller, and Carol Willick were off coming up with the name "Ben".
Monica Geller asks if Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing can come into the room.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller knows.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller would like Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing to meet Ben Geller and introduces Ben Geller to everybody.
Phoebe Buffay says Ben Geller looks just like Susan Bunch.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller actually has a baby.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing knows.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is still a baby.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is Ben Geller's aunt.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller will always have gum.
